header.description: Locate stage as ONE document: interchange scored over a 32-layer x 2-position grid. Axes are explicit {sweep: ...} wrappers on named table entries (sites.target.layers, positions.tap), so every read/write referencing the name moves together. The parser expands 64 points, dedups shared sub-values by content, and plans 64 patched forwards plus one shared counterfactual-harvest forward per row - where CLI multirun ran 64 separate processes, 128 forward groups, 64 model loads. The second position is the LAST TOKEN OF the entity span, not the span itself: a bare {variable: ...} window is ragged across rows whenever the entity tokenizes to different lengths (weekday names do); before writes declared a ragged policy (writes.<w>.ragged, [V19]) that spelling made 32 of these 64 points unrunnable, and this document keeps the last-token spelling because the last token is the position the scan asks about. 'entity' is also the name the shipped weekdays task emits; 'subject' - what this document swept before - exists in no task-generated table.
